issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as returning String, but the solution's Animal and its concrete implementations use a FeedResponse return type. This mismatch means students following the specification (implementing messageOnFeed() to return String) will produce code incompatible with the solution/tests (which expect FeedResponse), causing compilation failures or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type of messageOnFeed across artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement and UML to specify that messageOnFeed() returns FeedResponse and document the FeedResponse class, or (B) refactor the solution to have messageOnFeed() return String (and remove or adapt FeedResponse). Apply the chosen approach consistently in the template, problem text, and solution so students implement the correct signature.
